faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about DripCatch.
faq.q1: Do I need to connect my bank account?
faq.a1: Never. Unlike conventional budgeting apps, DripCatch does not ask for your bank credentials or open banking tokens. Your records remain private.
faq.q2: How do shared subscription splits work?
faq.a2: When creating a subscription, toggle 'Split Cost' and assign amounts to friends. You can invite them via email so they see their share and status.
faq.a3: A zombie subscription is a service you keep paying for on autopilot but haven't actively used in months. Marking it as a zombie isolates your potential savings.
faq.q4: Which currencies and billing frequencies are supported?
faq.a4: DripCatch supports EUR, USD, and regional currencies, along with weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly billing frequencies.
faq.a5: Yes, core ledger tracking, price hike detection, and split management are completely free.
